item.title: Hydra: The Greek island that banned wheels
item.description: Hydra is a unique Greek island in the Saronic Gulf known for banning all motorized vehicles, including cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. Enforced since the 1950s by a presidential decree to preserve its traditional architecture and tranquil,, old-world charm, the island relies entirely on donkeys, horses, mules, and walking for transportation.
